description: This file defines functions to collect, normalize, render, and write environment variable configurations related to bundled provider authentication. It appears to be a script used for code generation or configuration file generation within a larger project.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes an object containing provider IDs and their environment variables into a sorted array of pairs, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects provider authentication environment variables from plugin sources and returns a sorted object mapping provider IDs to environment variable arrays.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript module string that exports a constant mapping provider IDs to their environment variables in a formatted manner.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Writes the generated environment variable module to disk, resolving paths and utilizing external utility for file writing.
